title: 第四章 工藤新一的命运之夜
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

转眼已经在热狗屋工作了三天，终于到了周末。

“你的‘雷神拳热狗’儿童套餐，这是赠送的玩具，请拿好。”渚琰·剑勇正人将盒装热狗和一个廉价的假面超人小塑料人递给了柜台前的小孩。

“谢谢假面超人哥哥！”七八岁大的小男孩，接过热狗和玩具兴奋的说道。

“嘘——！”剑勇正人一本正经的示意小朋友安静下来：“关于我的身份，拜托请帮我保密哦！”

小朋友重重的点了点头，还用拿着玩具的小手捂住了自己的嘴，一副郑重保守秘密的样子。

不过想必周一上学的时候，他肯定会和同学去炫耀他吃过‘假面超人亲手制作的热狗’吧。或者说，他吃了一发‘假面超人雷神拳’只吃了个三分饱。

而在小朋友之后，还有一条二十几人的长队。

“两个‘假面超人雷神踢’热狗！”下一位顾客是一个胖乎乎的男生：“还有可以给我签名吗？”

“签名就签‘剑勇正人’可以吗？”

“再好不过了！”胖仔很兴奋的说道。

剑勇正人熟练的制作热狗，然后在包装盒上签下了名字。

这时，一阵警铃声刺穿了热带乐园的喧嚣：“威—呜——威—呜——”张灯结彩的乐园里，一排红蓝两色交替的闪光依旧瞩目。

“哇……不是吧。”胖仔听到熟悉的声音回头看去，脸色顿时一垮。

再看剑勇正人还没有做好第二个热狗，当即说道：“我突然有事需要离开一下，热狗我等下再来拿可以吗？钱已经付过了。”

“没问题。”剑勇正人在答应的同时，认真看了一眼千叶和伸的长相，确保他回来时自己还能认得对方。

千叶和伸转身朝着警车停下的方向跑去，虽然他今天是休假，但万一发生了案件，有用得着他的地方，他还是乐意帮忙的。

警车出现了，而且停下的位置还是云霄飞车，此时那里发生了什么，对于渚琰来说不言自明。

不过不着急，对云霄飞车杀人事件本身，渚琰并没有插手的理由和兴趣。

因为许多顾客都被警车吸引看热闹去了，忙碌许久的剑勇正人和店长夏目铃总算有了空闲歇口气。

一边慢悠悠的准备材料，夏目铃随口问道：“说起来，剑勇君就连名字也和假面超人的名字一模一样呢。”

剑勇正人的出现确实让热狗屋的生意红火了许多，并非特摄厨的夏目铃出于好奇和为了更好的做生意也抽时间租了碟片看。

然后她才知道，原来剧中的假面超人，真名就叫做‘剑勇正人’。

而渚琰·剑勇正人在应聘的时候就给她看过证件的，他的名字真的就叫这个。

再加上渚琰·剑勇正人有意模仿过剧中‘剑勇正人’的说话习惯、行为、神态。在他热情的招待客人、温柔的对待小朋友的时候，那微笑的面庞几乎和她刚看过的电视画面重合在了一起。

这家伙该不会背地里还真的是假面超人吧？

【提示：您遇到了身份暴露的危机。（演出任务·支：隐藏自己的真实身份。）】

居然怀疑我的身份真的是假面超人，店长小姐姐的想象力还真是夸张。

就像之前那种小朋友直接叫他假面超人的情况一天会发生上百次，但一次都不会触发系统的提示。反而是作为成年人的店长小姐姐，她来真的。

一面把手上的热狗装进盒中，剑勇正人一面低声答道：“当然是改名了，役所的工作人员没有看过假面超人，让我成功改成了现在的名字。这样我才能以剑勇正人的名义给他们签名而不会触犯版权。”

实际上，这种改名反而会构成不正当竞争和姓名权侵权，但是没关系，店长小姐姐虽不算法盲，但也不了解这么细，忽悠起来足够了。

“连名字都改掉了？”夏目铃瞪大眼睛：“为了挣钱吗？”

“没错，难得生了一张和佐藤健义一模一样的脸，不把它变现不是白白浪费了这先天条件吗？”剑勇正人很清楚自己的‘破绽’有哪些：“为了扮演好这个角色，我可是不怀一丝娱乐之情的看完了十遍《假面超人》，就为了模仿角色的神态和语气。”

说话时剑勇正人还挂着和剧中如出一辙的真诚微笑，可是说出的话和这副表情完全不匹配。

夏目铃心中惊诧：这家伙为了这个挣钱的计划超认真的啊。

不过这个计划也确实很成功，经过两个工作日的蓄势，这个周末热狗屋的顾客确实翻了番，而且大部分都是假面超人粉丝。

Page (1/3)

In the blink of an eye, I have been working at the hot dog house for three days, and the weekend is finally here.

"Your 'Thunder Fist Hot Dog' children's set, this is a free toy, please take it." Zhuyan Jianyong Masato handed the boxed hot dog and a cheap little plastic man of Masked Superman to the child at the counter.

"Thank you, Brother Masked Superman!" the seven or eight-year-old boy said excitedly as he took the hot dog and toys.

"Hush!" Mr. Jian Yong signaled the children to quiet down in a serious tone: "Please keep my identity a secret for me!"

The child nodded heavily and covered his mouth with the little hand holding the toy, as if he was solemnly keeping the secret.

But when he goes to school on Monday, he will definitely show off to his classmates that he has eaten a 'hot dog made by Masked Superman'.In other words, he was only three-thirds full after taking one shot of 'Masked Superman Thunder God Fist'.

After the children, there was a long queue of more than 20 people.

"Two 'Masked Superman Thor Kick' hot dogs!" The next customer was a chubby boy: "Can you also give me an autograph?"

"Can I just sign 'Jian Yong Zhengren'?"

"It couldn't be better!" Fatty said excitedly.

Kenyong Masato skillfully made hot dogs and then signed his name on the box.

At this time, a burst of alarm bells pierced the hustle and bustle of the tropical paradise: "Wow-woo-woo-woo--" In the paradise decorated with lights and colors, a row of alternating red and blue flashes of light was still eye-catching.

"Wow... no." Fatty looked back when he heard the familiar voice, his face suddenly fell.

Seeing that Jian Yongzhengren hadn't made the second hot dog yet, he immediately said: "I suddenly have something to do and need to leave for a while. Can I come back later to get the hot dogs? The money has been paid."

"No problem." While Masato Kenyong agreed, he took a serious look at Chiba and Nobu's appearance to ensure that he would still recognize each other when he came back.

Chiba and Nobu turned around and ran in the direction where the police car stopped. Although he was on vacation today, if a case happened and he was needed, he would still be happy to help.

The police car appeared, and it stopped where the roller coaster was. What happened there at this time was self-evident to Zhu Yan.

But don't worry, Zhu Yan has no reason or interest to intervene in the roller coaster murder incident itself.

Because many customers were attracted by the police car to watch the excitement, Kenyong Masato and the store manager Natsume Suzu, who had been busy for a long time, finally had time to take a breather.

While slowly preparing the materials, Natsume Suzu asked casually: "Speaking of which, even Kenyong-kun's name is exactly the same as Masked Superman's."

The appearance of Kenyong Masato really made the business of the hot dog house boom. Natsume Suzu, who is not a special cook, also took the time to rent the disc and watch it out of curiosity and for better business.

Then she found out that the real name of the Masked Superman in the show was ‘Sword Yong Masato’.

As for Zhuyan Jianyong, he showed her his ID when he applied for the job, and his name really was this.

In addition, Zhu Yan·Jian Yong Masato intentionally imitated the speaking habits, behavior, and demeanor of "Jian Yong Masato" in the play.When he entertained guests warmly and treated children tenderly, his smiling face almost overlapped with the TV picture she had just watched.

Could this guy really be the Masked Superman behind his back?

[Tip: You have encountered a crisis of identity exposure.(Performance task·Branch: Hide one’s true identity.)]

She actually suspected that I was really the Masked Superman. The store manager's imagination was really exaggerated.

Just like the previous situation where children directly called him Masked Superman, it would happen hundreds of times a day, but the system prompt would not be triggered even once.On the contrary, as an adult store manager, she takes it seriously.

While putting the hot dog on his hand into the box, Masato Kenyong replied in a low voice: "Of course the name has been changed. The staff at the office have not seen Masked Superman, so they allowed me to successfully change it to my current name. This way I can sign autographs for them in Masato Kenyong's name without violating copyright."

In fact, this kind of name change will constitute unfair competition and name rights infringement, but it doesn't matter. Although the store manager is not illiterate, she does not understand such details, so it is enough to deceive.

"You even changed your name?" Natsume Suzu's eyes widened: "Is it to make money?"

"Yes, it's rare to have a face that looks exactly like Sato Takeyoshi. If you don't realize it, wouldn't it be a waste of this innate condition?" Kenyong Masato is very clear about his "flaws": "In order to play this role well, I watched "Masked Man" ten times without any entertainment, just to imitate the character's expression and tone."

When speaking, Kenyong Masato still had a sincere smile that was exactly the same as in the play, but the words he spoke did not match his expression at all.

Natsume Suzu was surprised: This guy is so serious about this plan to make money.

However, this plan was indeed successful. After two working days of preparation, the number of customers at the hot dog house did double this weekend, and most of them were Masked Superman fans.
